messages:
Sophie: Kicking off a single thread for the Orion Health QBR (scheduled next Wed). Need slide owners, a concise renewal risk snapshot, and clear post-QBR next steps. Slides due Tue 16:00 PT.
Diego: I can own the exec narrative + adoption highlights. Planning a 2-slide hook: top 3 feature wins and the 30/60/90 retention cohorts. @Priya can you pull the cohort table and WAU counts?
Priya: Yep — pulling weekly active users, daily token peaks, and embeddings spend by product line. Will attach CSV + two PNGs (usage-trend, cost-by-feature) by Mon 23:00 UTC.
Tom: Ill own onboarding status & cutover plan. Current: 3 envs in pilot, 1 blocked on dedicated-capacity approval, 1 with SSO metadata mismatch. ETA for an updated timeline: Tue morning.
Elaine: Renewal risk note: CSAT slipped to 78 last month and finance flagged a Q2 spend review. Drafting mitigation slide with three offers (usage credits, Optimize playbook, limited-time credits) and an ROI table.
Sophie: Good. Please make the ask explicit on the slide (renew vs pause + recommended next step) so execs can make a decision.
Diego: Will add a single-line CTA and propose a 30-min technical workshop post-QBR to unblock SSO & capacity. Also including 2 bullets on latency improvements.
Priya: Customer requested a self-serve admin runbook and a recurring health digest (monthly). Ill include links in the appendix and add a sample digest mock.
Tom: Adding rollback/fallback bullets for the SSO cutover and listing me as point-of-contact for cutover-day break-fix.
infra-eng: Noted. Procurement is finalizing the dedicated pool approval; estimating 48h for sign-off once finance returns paperwork.
Sophie: Deck link: drive.redwood/orion-qbr (use the QBR template). When your slide is ready, add your initials in the top-right and update the slide index.
Diego: My slide checklist: exec readout, retention cohorts, workshop ask, and 1-line business impact.
Tom: My slide checklist: onboarding timeline, outstanding blockers, rollback plan, owners + dates.
Priya: My slide checklist: metrics snapshot, cost breakout, appendix with raw dashboards and runbook link.
Elaine: My slide checklist: risk matrix, three ROI scenarios (baseline, batching/caching, quantized-variant), and recommended concession strategy.
reminder-bot: Reminder: Orion QBR slides due Tue 23:00 UTC :alarm_clock: — please upload to the shared deck.
Sophie: Dry run scheduled Wed 10:30 PT (25-min run + 10-min feedback). Be ready to present your slides in order.
Diego: After QBR Ill create a JIRA epic for all onboarding items (SSO, capacity, admin runbook) and link it to the customer epic. Will post the JIRA link here.
Priya: Uploaded usage-trend.png and cost-by-feature.png to the deck, and added the admin runbook draft link. Confirmed.
Tom: Included SSO mismatch detail in slide notes and pinged infra for an interim workaround.
Elaine: ROI slide has three scenarios with ballpark numbers; will refine if finance asks for a deeper model.
Sophie: Decision log to capture during the QBR: renewal intent, workshop scheduling, capacity approval timeline, and SSO completion. Owners: add owner + due date to the shared action tracker.
Diego: Ill stand up the action tracker (Google sheet + JIRA epic) and paste links here after the dry run.
Sophie: Thanks all  if blockers come up, post them here so we can escalate. :thumbsup:
